usageNote: 双重否定表强烈肯定！说这句话其实是在夸，语气比'I was satisfied'更有惊喜感，像在说'还挺不错嘛'！

examples.en: I tried the new restaurant last night, and I wasn't disappointed — the food was amazing!
examples.zh: 我昨晚去了那家新餐厅，完全没失望——食物超棒！

examples.en: She said the movie was worth watching, and I wasn't disappointed at all.
examples.zh: 她说这部电影值得看，我看完果然没失望。
